mapper.insert: MERGE INTO asset_download_count t USING (VALUES (CAST(#{format} AS VARCHAR(100)), CAST(#{assetId} AS INT), CAST(#{repositoryId} AS INT), CAST(#{componentId, jdbcType=INTEGER} AS INT), CAST(#{downloadCount} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{lastDownloaded} AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE))) AS s (format, asset_id, repository_id, component_id, download_count, last_downloaded) ON t.format = s.format AND t.asset_id = s.asset_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET download_count = t.download_count + s.download_count, last_downloaded = GREATEST(t.last_downloaded, s.last_downloaded), component_id = COALESCE(s.component_id, t.component_id) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (format, asset_id, repository_id, component_id, download_count, last_downloaded) VALUES (s.format, s.asset_id, s.repository_id, s.component_id, s.download_count, s.last_downloaded);

INSERT INTO asset_download_count (format, asset_id, repository_id, component_id, download_count, last_downloaded) VALUES (#{format}, #{assetId}, #{repositoryId}, #{componentId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{downloadCount}, #{lastDownloaded}) ON CONFLICT (format, asset_id) DO UPDATE SET download_count = asset_download_count.download_count + EXCLUDED.download_count, last_downloaded = GREATEST(asset_download_count.last_downloaded, EXCLUDED.last_downloaded), component_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.component_id, asset_download_count.component_id);
